purpose: Initial source registry for AgriAI training and evidence retrieval. Candidate is not synonymous with verified or approved for training.

sources.name: Current daily price of various commodities from various markets (Mandi)
sources.provider: Open Government Data Platform India / Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Directorate of Marketing and Inspection
sources.temporal_resolution: Daily (source records may be delayed or missing)
sources.license_or_terms: NDSAP designation shown in catalog; review current catalog/API terms and attribution before production use
validation_checks: min <= modal <= max when all present
sources.notes: Observed prices are not necessarily live quotes. Forecasts must be stored/displayed separately from observed values.

sources.name: AGMARKNET portal
sources.provider: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection, Government of India
sources.license_or_terms: Review portal terms and underlying dataset terms before bulk ingestion or model training
sources.notes: Use as reference portal. Prefer documented data.gov.in resource/API for repeatable programmatic ingestion.

sources.name: Official agronomy and crop protection guidance
sources.provider: ICAR institutes, State Agricultural Universities, Krishi Vigyan Kendras and relevant government agencies
sources.geography: India; exact scope must be captured per document
sources.temporal_resolution: Publication or revision date per document
sources.license_or_terms: Per-source copyright/license/access terms must be reviewed; public accessibility alone is not a training license

sources.name: PlantVillage plant-health image dataset
sources.geography: Research dataset; not necessarily representative of Indian field conditions
sources.license_or_terms: Review original dataset owner's license and share-alike obligations before model training and redistribution
required_checks: grouped split by source/plant where IDs permit

sources.name: YieldSAT multimodal crop-yield benchmark
sources.geography: Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay and Germany described by the dataset; not direct India-ground-truth
sources.license_or_terms: Verify current data access and license with dataset owners before use
sources.notes: Potential external benchmark/pretraining research only; does not validate accuracy for Indian crops without local evaluation.

sources.name: SoilGrids soil-property maps
sources.license_or_terms: Verify current license, API and attribution conditions against the original provider
sources.notes: Map-derived estimates are not equivalent to a current laboratory soil test; preserve spatial resolution and uncertainty.

sources.name: NASA POWER meteorology and solar data
sources.license_or_terms: Verify current API usage and citation/attribution instructions
sources.notes: Do not present historical/reanalysis observations as a live forecast.

sources.name: AgriMark first-party farmer, cultivation and harvest records
sources.license_or_terms: Private personal/farm data; explicit purpose and lawful basis/consent, access control, retention policy, and de-identification review required before any model training
sources.notes: Never put private farmer records in public evidence retrieval. Restrict every query to authorized users and purpose.
